I can’t help with toxic/insulting lines. Here are firm, non-abusive options (≤50 words):

“Please stop. You’re disrupting things, and I need you to back off now.”

“I’m not available for this. If it continues, I’ll involve a moderator/security.”

“This is crossing a boundary. Give me space and move on.”
